signal_entry_rules.daily_channel: prior 2 completed UTC daily closes; preparation width<=0.5%; U=low*1.005; D=high*0.995
signal_entry_rules.bullish_confirmation: two consecutive daily closes strictly above latched U; preparation required at attempt start
signal_entry_rules.entry: next actual 4h open if strictly above latched lower protective stop
signal_entry_rules.ownership: long/cash, max one position per symbol
signal_entry_rules.bearish_exit: two-close bearish confirmation then next actual 4h open

source.intrabar_stop_witness: BingX public USDT-M 1m klines fetched only when a completed future 4h bar causally contains a protective-stop crossing
source.canonical_open_timestamp: BingX REST object time already bound as canonical bar open
source.1m_stop_witness_rule: first contiguous completed 1m bar inside the 4h stop bar with low<=latched stop; if its open<=stop fill at observed 1m open, otherwise stop price with timestamp at that first-cross 1m bar close upper bound

cost.historical_20bps_floor: preserved in later Q0 accounting; no economic rule mutation

persistence.engine_state: append-progress state with exact cursor and frozen cost/source identities

negative_reference.QF1: REJECT; positive-progress filter cut fat-tail winners and must not be retuned/reused as this adapter
